subject: Download large csv file from a Shiny app

messages.author: a5291522e054e0cd
messages.subject: Download large csv file from a Shiny app
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am adding a download functionality to my app using downloadHandler. Everything works perfect for small dataset both locally and from Shiny server. But with large dataset (e.g. 80MB csv file), it doesn't work from Shiny server. After clicking on the download button, it takes quite a while to respond and finally shows a Server Error saying "502 - web server received an invalid response while acting as a gateway or proxy server". Anyone has any thought or experience with that? Very much appreciated.

Xiaochen

Hi Joe,

The server error described below is temporarily solved by changing the time-out setting. Another issue that I found is that if I repeat downloading generated (large size) files without closing the app, the memory usage will accumulate. I don't know how the download functionality is implemented internally. Is there a way to prevent the memory from accumulating? Thanks very much again!

Xiaochen
